post.summary:
Create a booking.

Validates CID, date, start/end time, position, and optional tag, then persists a
new booking, forcing a training tag when the controller or position rating requires it

cid.description: The VATSIM CID (user ID) to create the booking for.

start_at.description: The booking start time, in 24-hour `H:i` format.

end_at.description: The booking end time, in 24-hour `H:i` format.

position.description: The callsign of the position to book.

tag.description: The booking type: `1` for training, `2` for exam, `3` for event.

source.description: The booking source; use `CC` for Control Center bookings.

200.description: The booking was created. `tag` is only present when a training tag was forced.

400.description: The booking could not be created — for example the start and end time are equal, the start time is in the past, or it overlaps an existing booking.

patch.summary:
Update an existing booking.

Revalidates CID, date, start/end time, position, and optional tag, re-checks for
overlapping bookings, and re-evaluates whether a training tag must be forced

cid.description: The VATSIM CID (user ID) the booking belongs to.

start_at.description: The booking start time, in 24-hour `H:i` format.

end_at.description: The booking end time, in 24-hour `H:i` format.

position.description: The callsign of the position to book.

tag.description: The booking type: `1` for training, `2` for exam, `3` for event.

delete.summary:
Delete a booking.

Soft-deletes the booking and cancels the corresponding VATSIM booking

post.description:
Creates a request for a staff member, such as a rating upgrade, regarding a training.
`type` is the task type class name, for example `RatingUpgrade`, `TheoreticalExam`,
`SoloEndorsement` or `Custom`. `actor_cid` is recorded as the creator.

subject_user_id.description: The student the task concerns. Defaults to the student of the training.

409.description: The assignee is not allowed to receive tasks.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The task status: `0` pending, `1` completed, `-1` declined.

200.description: Paginated tasks, newest first, filterable by status, type, assignee, creator, subject user, and training.

post.description:
Runs the type specific completion, such as requesting a rating upgrade from the Division API.
`actor_cid` is required when the Division API is involved.

422.description: Validation failed or the Division API rejected the request.

post.description:
Staff creation for a student by `user_id` or `cid`. A student can only have one open
training at a time, and refresh or familiarisation trainings must cover every active
endorsement of the student in the area.

user_id.description: The VATSIM CID of the student. Alias of `cid`.

cid.description: The VATSIM CID of the student. Alias of `user_id`.

type.description: The training type: `1` Standard, `2` Refresh, `3` Transfer, `4` Fast-track, `5` Familiarisation.

409.description: The student already has an open training, or a refresh training does not cover their active endorsements.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

200.description: Paginated trainings, newest first, filterable by status, area, user, and type.

patch.description:
Every field is optional. `mentors` replaces the whole mentor list (an `expire_at` defaults
to 12 months for new mentors), `paused` starts or ends the pause accounting, and
`rating_ids` replaces the ratings while keeping the parts already completed. Setting a
closed status runs the same close flow as the close endpoint.

status.description: The new status: `-2` closed by staff, `-1` completed, `0` in queue, `1` pre-training, `2` active training, `3` awaiting exam.

422.description: Validation failed or the Division API rejected the completion.

409.description: The change was refused: reopening over another open training, a mentor who may not mentor in the area, or a refresh training that does not cover the active endorsements.

200.description: The training with its ratings and mentors.

post.description:
Closes an open training as closed by staff (default) or completed, detaching the
mentors and notifying the student with the optional reason.

status.description: The closed status: `-2` closed by staff (default) or `-1` completed.

reason.description: Shown to the student in the closure e-mail.

422.description: Validation failed or the Division API rejected the completion.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

post.description:
Completes the whole training, granting the endorsement of every facility rating
through the Division API, and closes it.

409.description: Only a training in progress can be completed.

422.description: Validation failed or the Division API rejected the endorsement.

Only a training awaiting its exam can receive an examination. `actor_cid` is the examiner,
and is required when result files are uploaded for an S2+ examination, because they are
forwarded to the Division API. The student and mentors are notified, and a rating upgrade
task is created when `request_task_user_id` is given.

get.summary:
List users.

Returns users filtered by the `onlyAtcActive` query parameter, with relations and
fields (name, email, divisions, active areas, endorsements, roles, training) added
only when requested via the `include[]` query parameter

parameters.name: onlyAtcActive
parameters.description: Restrict results to users who are currently ATC active.

parameters.name: include[]
parameters.description: Additional data to include in the response. Allowed values: allUsers, endorsements, roles, training, name, email, divisions, activeAreas.

200.description: The matching users, wrapped in a `data` array. Each user always includes `id`, `rating`, and `atc_active`; all other fields and relations appear only when requested via the `include[]` query parameter.

get.summary:
Show a single user.

Accepts the same `include[]` values as the list endpoint

200.description: A single user. Always includes `id`, `rating`, and `atc_active`; other fields appear when requested via `include[]`.
